notes.script/0:
1) ls -lh --> used for lising file in detail
2) ls -la --> used for listing hidden files/folder
3) cp source.txt backup.txt -->copy file
4) cp -r source_folder backup_folder --> copy folder
5) mv old.parquet new.parquet --> rename 
6) mv file.parquet /data/archive/ --> move folder or files 
7) head file.txt  -->1st 10 lines
8) tail file.txt  -->last 10 lines
